principles: Standard constructs are selected from versioned instruments; AI maps a brief to instruments instead of inventing wording.
Client-specific brand, concept, product and scenario text is parameterized through explicit slots.
An instrument may be method-locked before external source binding. source_status makes that distinction explicit.
Anchor eligibility never creates truth: a benchmark is usable only when an explicit external or audience-scoped target exists.
